import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath('.codex/skills/docx'))

from scripts.document import Document

RPR = ('<w:rPr><w:rFonts w:ascii="Helvetica Light" w:hAnsi="Helvetica Light" w:cs="Helvetica Light"/>'
       '<w:sz w:val="24"/><w:sz-cs w:val="24"/></w:rPr>')

def para(text):
    if text == "":
        t = '<w:t xml:space="preserve"/>'
    else:
        t = f'<w:t xml:space="preserve">{text}</w:t>'
    return f'<w:p><w:pPr/>{RPR}<w:r>{t}</w:r></w:p>'

doc = Document('unpacked', rsid='8E916A99')

# Locate the last content paragraph (Risk Factors body) - insert new section after it
node = doc["word/document.xml"].get_node(tag="w:p", contains="Key risks include")

section = (
    para("") + para("") +
    para("RECOMMENDATIONS") + para("") +
    para("Based on the strong Q4 2024 results and the Q1 2025 outlook, management recommends the following actions to sustain growth and mitigate risk:") + para("") +
    para("• Prioritize continued investment in Cloud Services, which delivered the strongest segment growth at 22.8% YoY and is a key driver of overall revenue expansion.") +
    para("• Maintain disciplined cost management in Sales & Marketing, building on the 8.3% reduction in customer acquisition costs and the 14.1% increase in customer lifetime value.") +
    para("• Proceed with international market expansion and new product launches, consistent with Q1 2025 guidance of 10-13% revenue growth and operating margins above 22%.") +
    para("• Retain currency hedging strategies and diversify the supply chain to address the key risks identified in the Risk Factors section.")
)

doc["word/document.xml"].insert_after(node, section)
doc.save()
